req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at the endpoint GET /docs. The test suite will verify this by checking for a successful response, handling of incorrect paths, and boundary conditions around the endpoint.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and configured correctly.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'Swagger UI' in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and configured correctly.
actions: Send a GET request to a non-existent endpoint /docs-invalid.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs-invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and configured correctly.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with a trailing slash.
expected: The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'Swagger UI' in response.text
